profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Virtru
profile.summary: I am an aspiring data scientist with a passion for Python Programming Language, deep learning, and software development. My current goal is to use my engineering skills to help design solutions to problems faced by people around the globe and make their lives easier through technology. I'm always open to new opportunities and ideas that can help me grow as a professional.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created an automation suite using Autosys and Python, to reduce manual intervention during executions.

Developed, tested and debugged ETL workflows and mappings using Informatica and Talend.

Developed automation and deployment utilities for Jenkins (CI/CD) using Python and Shell scripting.

Developed using AWS services such as Lambda, Step Functions, and etc.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Course Taught: Introduction to PHP & Javascript

Assisted students on web-based application projects using Linux, PHP, JavaScript, MySQL/MariaDB, and Apache.

Graded labs, homework, projects, midterm and final exams.

Held weekly office hours where students may get help on homework, labs, and any course concepts.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Assisted architects, engineers, and product managers to deliver user-friendly and visually appealing mobile applications for the Android platform.

Worked with .NET Framework 4.0/4.5, ASP.NET, C# .NET and Microsoft SQL Server.

Developed, tested, and debugged software to enhance products and services.

positions.title: Lead Teacher
positions.description:
Coordinated the operations of the classes.
Prepared lessons, controlled inventory, and handled logistics while managing assistant teachers
and students.
